description: Connect to a board's ROM bootloader and report the chip, its eFuse security state and the partition table. A job: board.progress, then board.finished with `info` and `partitions`. The board is reset back into its firmware afterwards when reset is auto.

reset.description: How to enter the bootloader. auto (default): the USB sequence for USB-Serial-JTAG boards, DTR/RTS otherwise. none: the chip is already in download mode.

stub.description: Use espflash's RAM stub (faster). Default true; the ROM loader alone also works.
